research_problem: Can wearable ECG age indicate atrial-fibrillation presence and burden?
ai_method: A residual network trained on one million ECGs uses GAN-derived single-lead signals and independent wearable validation.
study_summary: Age-estimation errors were roughly 10–12 years; larger ECG-age gaps were associated with AF presence and higher burden across two cohorts.
outcome_summary: Age-estimation errors were roughly 10–12 years; larger ECG-age gaps were associated with AF presence and higher burden across two cohorts.
limitations: Associations do not establish prospective AF prevention, and synthetic training signals may differ from actual wearable recordings.
manual_review: Original publisher abstract read and interpreted; no full-text review claimed.

research_problem: Does a messaging-based AI agent improve orthopedic postoperative care?
ai_method: A randomized trial compared GPT-4 support through WeChat with routine doctor-led communication in 261 patients.
study_summary: AI responded much faster and improved early function and satisfaction, but response accuracy was slightly lower and six-month outcomes were similar.
outcome_summary: AI responded much faster and improved early function and satisfaction, but response accuracy was slightly lower and six-month outcomes were similar.
limitations: Short-term benefits did not persist as significant between-group differences; AI support still requires attention to erroneous advice.
manual_review: Original publisher abstract read and interpreted; no full-text review claimed.

research_problem: Which cell programs accompany fatty-liver progression to steatohepatitis?
ai_method: Integrated single-cell, spatial, and bulk transcriptomics are combined with ensemble machine-learning biomarker prediction.
study_summary: DTNA-positive macrophages and stellate-cell interactions implicated a RUNX2-related fibrotic axis; classification of disease stages averaged AUC 0.839.
outcome_summary: DTNA-positive macrophages and stellate-cell interactions implicated a RUNX2-related fibrotic axis; classification of disease stages averaged AUC 0.839.
limitations: Public-data associations and inferred cell communication nominate mechanisms rather than proving causality or validating a noninvasive clinical test.
manual_review: Original publisher abstract read and interpreted; no full-text review claimed.

research_problem: Can remote cognitive testing detect dementia-related impairment across languages and ages?
ai_method: Four OCTAL browser-based validation studies evaluated cognitive tasks, clinical discrimination, and reliability in 1,664 participants.
study_summary: In a 194-person memory-clinic cohort, brief and extended assessments achieved Alzheimer-versus-subjective-decline AUCs of 0.92 and 0.97, with good retest reliability.
outcome_summary: In a 194-person memory-clinic cohort, brief and extended assessments achieved Alzheimer-versus-subjective-decline AUCs of 0.92 and 0.97, with good retest reliability.
limitations: The abstract describes digital testing rather than a substantive learned-AI model; clinic discrimination does not establish population screening utility.
manual_review: Original publisher abstract read and interpreted; no full-text review claimed.

research_problem: Can pathology classifiers remain reliable across scanners and institutions?
ai_method: StructMIL combines tissue graphs, prototype pooling, contrastive alignment, adversarial confusion, and consistency training.
study_summary: Camelyon16 cross-center AUC reached 0.967, while PANDA grading improved kappa relative to prior multiple-instance approaches under scanner shifts.
outcome_summary: Camelyon16 cross-center AUC reached 0.967, while PANDA grading improved kappa relative to prior multiple-instance approaches under scanner shifts.
limitations: Benchmark domain-shift robustness and attribution maps do not establish prospective diagnostic safety across all new clinical sites.

research_problem: Can continuous lesion representations capture stroke detail missed by binary masks?
ai_method: StrokeFlow predicts an ischemic density field and an ADC-gradient-supervised vector field from diffusion MRI.
study_summary: ISLES 2022 evaluation improved boundary-distance metrics and sensitivity to small or multifocal lesions over compared segmentation baselines.
outcome_summary: ISLES 2022 evaluation improved boundary-distance metrics and sensitivity to small or multifocal lesions over compared segmentation baselines.
limitations: ADC-aligned vector fields are modeled imaging representations, not direct measurements of perfusion dynamics or evidence of improved stroke treatment.

research_problem: Can continuous vessel representations preserve vascular geometry and topology?
ai_method: FlowAxis models adaptive interconnected vessel-axis keypoints with a geometric-topological optimization formulation.
study_summary: Four three-dimensional vascular benchmarks showed improved centerline topology and boundary fidelity, with supporting theoretical convergence arguments.
outcome_summary: Four three-dimensional vascular benchmarks showed improved centerline topology and boundary fidelity, with supporting theoretical convergence arguments.
limitations: Mathematical guarantees apply under stated model assumptions; benchmark performance does not guarantee safety or clinical benefit in arbitrary scans.

research_problem: Can combined PET biomarkers improve obstructive-coronary-disease diagnosis?
ai_method: XGBoost integrates ten PET/CT-derived and clinical parameters, trained at one center and externally tested at three.
study_summary: Among 1,664 angiography-selected patients, external-test AUC was 0.83, exceeding physicians and individual perfusion or flow biomarkers.
outcome_summary: Among 1,664 angiography-selected patients, external-test AUC was 0.83, exceeding physicians and individual perfusion or flow biomarkers.

research_problem: Can slide-level labels support accurate gastric-cancer segmentation?
ai_method: Geo-MIL constructs tissue-patch graphs with topological attention to prioritize diagnostic structures.
study_summary: Experiments on three public gastric datasets improved both segmentation and classification over compared weakly supervised approaches.
outcome_summary: Experiments on three public gastric datasets improved both segmentation and classification over compared weakly supervised approaches.
limitations: The abstract supplies no numeric effects or cohort sizes; benchmark segmentation gains do not establish prospective pathologist assistance or patient benefit.

research_problem: Can longitudinal models predict individual myopia progression with and without intervention?
ai_method: Transformer modules learn natural progression from 304,353 young people and intervention trajectories from four treatment cohorts.
study_summary: Predictions generalized externally, with strong refractive and axial-length agreement and individualized modeled treatment effects.
outcome_summary: Predictions generalized externally, with strong refractive and axial-length agreement and individualized modeled treatment effects.

research_problem: Can embryo videos and clinical records jointly predict several IVF outcomes?
ai_method: VaTEP combines time-lapse reconstruction and developmental-stage pretraining with video sampling and multitask multimodal learning.
study_summary: The framework estimates heartbeat, singleton versus multiple pregnancy, and miscarriage versus live birth probabilities.
outcome_summary: The framework estimates heartbeat, singleton versus multiple pregnancy, and miscarriage versus live birth probabilities.

research_problem: Can kidney-transplant prediction and policy reasoning become auditable?
ai_method: KT-LLM coordinates sequence-based survival modeling, recipient clustering, and policy-rule agents grounded in versioned transplant references.

outcome_summary: Deidentified OPTN/UNOS evaluations improved evidence attribution and predictive calibration while identifying recipient subgroup heterogeneity.

research_problem: Can genetic knowledge improve osteoarthritis drug-repurposing predictions?
ai_method: CausalPathKG adapts RotatE embeddings with GWAS-weighted links, pathway regularization, graph attention, and negative sampling.

outcome_summary: An osteoarthritis graph incorporating genetic evidence from nearly two million individuals improved held-out treatment-link prediction over simpler embedding baselines.

research_problem: Can one spine CT model segment, number, and localize vertebral abnormalities across domains?
ai_method: VertebraFormer combines a transformer encoder, task-specific decoders, and dynamic domain modulation on the four-source MultiSpine benchmark.
study_summary: Experiments improved accuracy and robustness across three tasks, supported by perturbation, efficiency, and ablation analyses.
outcome_summary: Experiments improved accuracy and robustness across three tasks, supported by perturbation, efficiency, and ablation analyses.

research_problem: Can AI accelerate aneurysm volumetry before and after endovascular repair?
ai_method: A segmentation network measures aneurysm, lumen, and thrombus volumes on CTA with internal/external validation and surgeon workflow assessment.
study_summary: Total-aneurysm Dice reached 0.972 internally and 0.960 externally; model assistance saved about 117 seconds, or 56%, per assessment.
outcome_summary: Total-aneurysm Dice reached 0.972 internally and 0.960 externally; model assistance saved about 117 seconds, or 56%, per assessment.

research_problem: Can computational surveillance identify lifitegrast adverse-event signals?
ai_method: Machine learning combines FAERS reports, language-derived reaction patterns, drug-gene networks, and molecular docking.
study_summary: Across 4,511 reports, the model achieved AUC 0.892 and identified 16 signals, alongside candidate regulatory genes and predicted binding interactions.
outcome_summary: Across 4,511 reports, the model achieved AUC 0.892 and identified 16 signals, alongside candidate regulatory genes and predicted binding interactions.

research_problem: Do safety guardrails change language-model responses to irritability prompts?
ai_method: Four models with different guardrail levels completed three irritability instruments under baseline and provoked conditions.
study_summary: Lower-guardrail models increased irritability scores, whereas highly guarded models suppressed them, sometimes to zero.
outcome_summary: Lower-guardrail models increased irritability scores, whereas highly guarded models suppressed them, sometimes to zero.

research_problem: Can video models distinguish nocturnal seizures from parasomnias?
ai_method: A SlowFast network classifies sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy, arousal disorders, and REM sleep behavior disorder from recordings.
study_summary: Across three data splits involving 167 individuals, mean classification accuracy was 83.3%, supporting preliminary automated event assessment.
outcome_summary: Across three data splits involving 167 individuals, mean classification accuracy was 83.3%, supporting preliminary automated event assessment.

research_problem: Can breath-sensor AI distinguish lung cancer, gastric cancer, and healthy controls?
ai_method: A hierarchical convolutional network first separates cancer from controls, then distinguishes cancer types using multimodal gas-sensor response maps.
study_summary: Fivefold validation in 206 participants yielded class AUCs around 0.89–0.92 and outperformed a one-dimensional CNN.
outcome_summary: Fivefold validation in 206 participants yielded class AUCs around 0.89–0.92 and outperformed a one-dimensional CNN.

research_problem: Can a compact MRI model classify cognitive states and highlight suspicious regions?
ai_method: CVTC combines scale-adaptive transformer features with coordinate-guided attribution and a visualization interface.
study_summary: ADNI and other datasets showed high reported classification accuracy, with additional tumor and multiple-sclerosis tests of annotation behavior.

research_problem: Can autonomous agents optimize prompts for detecting cognitive concerns in notes?
ai_method: Five specialized agents coordinate prompt refinement, compared with expert-driven workflows and prevalence-reflecting validation.
study_summary: The agentic method approached expert-workflow performance, but sensitivity fell from 0.91 to 0.62 between refinement and validation datasets; re-adjudication explained some apparent errors.
outcome_summary: The agentic method approached expert-workflow performance, but sensitivity fell from 0.91 to 0.62 between refinement and validation datasets; re-adjudication explained some apparent errors.

research_problem: Can adaptive multi-agent reasoning support multidisciplinary cancer recommendations?
ai_method: EvoMDT updates prompts, consensus weights, and retrieval scope using feedback, with evidence-linked specialist agents.
study_summary: Six QA benchmarks, four oncology datasets, and physician ratings favored guideline alignment and reported 30–40% faster responses, with fewer assessed safety violations.
outcome_summary: Six QA benchmarks, four oncology datasets, and physician ratings favored guideline alignment and reported 30–40% faster responses, with fewer assessed safety violations.

research_problem: Do language-model education tools improve preoperative and discharge outcomes?
ai_method: A systematic review narratively synthesized 20 studies and assessed evaluation coverage with a four-dimensional framework.
study_summary: Some studies found lower anxiety and better satisfaction, while pain, recovery, and other satisfaction outcomes often showed no significant improvement.
outcome_summary: Some studies found lower anxiety and better satisfaction, while pain, recovery, and other satisfaction outcomes often showed no significant improvement.

research_problem: How do Parkinson-related brain-network changes relate to diagnosis?
ai_method: A multilevel meta-analysis synthesized network topology and a separate diagnostic evidence subset.
study_summary: Eighty studies involving 3,736 patients and 2,384 controls showed reduced network segregation; ten diagnostic studies yielded pooled AUC 0.86, with stronger combined-metric performance.
outcome_summary: Eighty studies involving 3,736 patients and 2,384 controls showed reduced network segregation; ten diagnostic studies yielded pooled AUC 0.86, with stronger combined-metric performance.

research_problem: Can synthetic polyp images improve detector generalization?
ai_method: Conditional StyleGAN augmentation supplements YOLOv5 training with public colorectal images.
study_summary: Using over 150,000 source images, hybrid training increased internal mean average precision from 0.86 to 0.93 and flat/depressed-lesion recall from 0.72 to 0.87, with better external transfer.
outcome_summary: Using over 150,000 source images, hybrid training increased internal mean average precision from 0.86 to 0.93 and flat/depressed-lesion recall from 0.72 to 0.87, with better external transfer.

research_problem: Can machine learning improve survival prediction for extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma?
ai_method: Sixteen algorithms were compared using clinical and pathological predictors, selecting gradient boosting for an ENKTL score.
study_summary: Four cohorts totaling 977 people supported evaluation/external concordance around 0.82–0.84 and stronger risk stratification than established scores.
outcome_summary: Four cohorts totaling 977 people supported evaluation/external concordance around 0.82–0.84 and stronger risk stratification than established scores.
limitations: Discrimination and decision curves do not establish improved treatment selection or patient survival; an online calculator still requires local validation.

research_problem: How do obesity genetic risk and lifestyle relate to mortality?
ai_method: Stacked machine learning builds a polygenic score using UK Biobank and Nanfang Hospital data, followed by mortality association analyses.
study_summary: External obesity discrimination was modest at AUC 0.565; healthier lifestyles among genetically high-risk participants were associated with lower mortality.
outcome_summary: External obesity discrimination was modest at AUC 0.565; healthier lifestyles among genetically high-risk participants were associated with lower mortality.
limitations: The reported 59% relative mortality reduction is observational, not a randomized lifestyle effect; genetic-score prediction weakened externally.

research_problem: Can targeted ocular segmentation improve sign detection while limiting facial exposure?
ai_method: DSE-Net isolates ocular structures, followed by classifiers for thyroid-eye-disease signs across multinational images.
study_summary: A retrospective study of 2,360 eyes showed improved segmentation and detection relative to broader facial inputs, but external sign AUCs ranged widely from 0.556 to 0.843.
outcome_summary: A retrospective study of 2,360 eyes showed improved segmentation and detection relative to broader facial inputs, but external sign AUCs ranged widely from 0.556 to 0.843.

research_problem: Can task-specific patient summaries improve multimodal clinical prediction and explanations?
ai_method: xHAIM uses generative AI to select relevant data, summarize patients, and link predictions to patient-specific information.
study_summary: On HAIM-MIMIC-MM, mean AUC across chest pathology and operative tasks increased from 0.799 to 0.913 relative to HAIM.
outcome_summary: On HAIM-MIMIC-MM, mean AUC across chest pathology and operative tasks increased from 0.799 to 0.913 relative to HAIM.

research_problem: Can integrated molecular profiling identify aggressive prostate-cancer states and targets?
ai_method: Single-cell/spatial analysis of 141,986 cells is combined with 101 candidate prognostic pipelines and SHAP interpretation.
study_summary: A malignant epithelial state supported recurrence-risk prediction; PCSK1N experiments in organoids and xenografts connected the candidate to growth and androgen-therapy resistance.

research_problem: How do structural variants and chromatin architecture contribute to kidney cancer?

research_problem: Can blood transcriptomic features complement plasma biomarkers for Alzheimer detection?
ai_method: Random-forest feature selection and partial-least-squares modeling derive a lactylation-related score, combined with phosphorylated tau.
study_summary: Across multiple datasets and a 540-person plasma cohort, score AUC fell from 0.897 in training to 0.772 clinically; the combined marker model reached 0.859.

ai_method: Seven models were evaluated using TCGA, CPTAC, and multicenter data, selecting the multimodal PORCELAIN region-based model.

ai_method: A vision-language segmentation model links report generation with Segment Anything using 64,098 images and 21,355 reports from three hospitals.

research_problem: Can a topology-aware network locate pediatric central-catheter tips more reliably?
ai_method: TopNet preserves catheter continuity during radiograph segmentation, with internal and external evaluation.

research_problem: Can automated hospital-data curation support governed multispecialty AI research?
ai_method: S-RACE combines local anonymization, NLP extraction, FHIR standardization, and an explainable-model development environment.
